LanguageData.REBA001.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the chief of [PAWN_possessive] tribe unit it was wiped out by raiders. Now [PAWN_pronoun] wanders the Rimworld waiting for a chance at revenge.
LanguageData.REBA001.title: Chieftain
LanguageData.REBA002.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a noble lord. [PAWN_pronoun] has decided to wander the rimworld to test [PAWN_possessive] mettle against this harsh world before returning to lead [PAWN_possessive] people.
LanguageData.REBA002.title: Medieval lord
LanguageData.REBA003.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an exiled senator. [PAWN_possessive] political enemies came for [PAWN_objective] one night and [PAWN_pronoun] was forced to flee. [PAWN_pronoun] hopes to build a following on this new world and return for vengeance when possible.
LanguageData.REBA003.title: Senator
LanguageData.REBA004.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an urbworld gang leader. [PAWN_pronoun] left his crew behind when [PAWN_pronoun] was betrayed. [PAWN_nameDef] hopes to start a new gang on this forsaken world and rise to be its crime kingpin.
LanguageData.REBA004.title: Gang leader
LanguageData.REBA005.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a governor on this rimworld until his colony was overrun by raiders. Now [PAWN_pronoun] wanders the Rimworld waiting for a chance at revenge.
LanguageData.REBA005.title: Governor
LanguageData.REBA006.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a union boss on a caveworld. [PAWN_pronoun] has decided to dedicate [PAWN_possessive] life to supporting the rights of the workers in the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA006.title: Union boss
LanguageData.REBA007.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a combat engineer. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to build structures as well as how to tear them down. Now [PAWN_nameDef] has decided to put [PAWN_possessive] skills to use helping to build and defend a colony on the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA007.title: Combat engineer
LanguageData.REBA008.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a sheriff of the outer rim. [PAWN_pronoun] is responsible for enforcing the loose semblance of law that this world has.
LanguageData.REBA008.title: Sheriff
LanguageData.REBA009.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an urbworld assassin dedicated to eliminating [PAWN_possessive] targets. [PAWN_pronoun] has tracked one of them to this rimworld and [PAWN_pronoun] will kill anyone who gets in [PAWN_possessive] way.
LanguageData.REBA009.title: Assassin
LanguageData.REBA010.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a tribal trapper in charge of bringing food to [PAWN_possessive] tribe until one day [PAWN_pronoun] was the one who was trapped and sold off to the highest bidder. Now [PAWN_nameDef] is far from home.
LanguageData.REBA010.title: Trapper
LanguageData.REBA011.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a Medieval archer. Tired of war [PAWN_pronoun] hung up [PAWN_possessive] bow and snuck aboard a spaceship. Now [PAWN_nameDef] utilizes [PAWN_possessive] talents defending and feeding the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA011.title: Medieval archer
LanguageData.REBA012.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a glitterworld drop pod trooper. A machine of death and destruction [PAWN_pronoun] saw the end of many worlds. Now after many years of destroying [PAWN_pronoun] has traveled to the outer rim to help build something.
LanguageData.REBA012.title: Drop pod trooper
LanguageData.REBA013.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a tribal medicine man. [PAWN_pronoun] was exiled from [PAWN_possessive] tribe for [PAWN_possessive] outlandish ideas and now travels the outer rim healing those [PAWN_pronoun] comes across.
LanguageData.REBA013.title: Medicine man
LanguageData.REBA014.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was exiled from [PAWN_possessive] lord's court when [PAWN_pronoun] failed to turn lead into gold. Now [PAWN_nameDef] travels the outer rim searching for a greater understanding of the elements.
LanguageData.REBA014.title: Medieval alchemist
LanguageData.REBA015.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a glitterworld surgeon. [PAWN_pronoun] saved countless lives. However [PAWN_nameDef] knew that [PAWN_pronoun] could do more good somewhere lacking a doctor with [PAWN_possessive] skills, so he traveled to the outer rim to make a real difference.
LanguageData.REBA015.title: Glitterworld surgeon
LanguageData.REBA016.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a black market butcher. [PAWN_pronoun] deals with reclaiming organs from illegal sources for a variety of purposes. [PAWN_nameDef] has traveled to the outer rim to avoid the long reach of the law.
LanguageData.REBA016.title: Black market butcher
LanguageData.REBA017.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a field medic, able to save lives in even the roughest environments. There are few proper hospitals in the outer rim so [PAWN_nameDef] has learned to triage and treat patients in the field. Due to the lawlessness of the outer rim [PAWN_pronoun] has also learned how to use a gun.
LanguageData.REBA017.title: Field medic
LanguageData.REBA018.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is fungus cultivator, a grower of food and medicine for his caveworld. [PAWN_pronoun] knows which mushrooms heal, which mushrooms are tasty and which mushrooms kill.
LanguageData.REBA018.title: Fungus cultivator
LanguageData.REBA019.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a tribal weaver. While [PAWN_possessive] crafts are primitive nobody can deny [PAWN_possessive] artistic talents.
LanguageData.REBA019.title: Weaver
LanguageData.REBA020.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is medieval sculptor. [PAWN_pronoun] assists in the building of grand buildings and [PAWN_possessive] statues are famous across [PAWN_possessive] home world. Now [PAWN_nameDef] tours the outer rim leaving [PAWN_possessive] mark on this wild, untamed place.
LanguageData.REBA020.title: Medieval sculptor
LanguageData.REBA021.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is glitterworld holographic designer. [PAWN_pronoun] creates amazing holographic pieces of art that are famous across the galaxy. Looking for inspiration [PAWN_nameDef] has traveled to the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA021.title: Holographic designer
LanguageData.REBA022.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an urbworld graffiti artist. [PAWN_pronoun] is almost as skilled with a gun as [PAWN_pronoun] is with a spray-can as tagging rival territory is dangerous business. [PAWN_nameDef] has decided to leave his mark on the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA022.title: Graffiti artist
LanguageData.REBA023.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an taxidermist in the outer rim. [PAWN_pronoun] takes animal carcasses and turns them into stunning works of art.
LanguageData.REBA023.title: Taxidermist
LanguageData.REBA024.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a cave painter. [PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] time creating brilliant pieces of art on his caveworld. However only very few of the inhabitants of his home world has an appreciation for art. [PAWN_nameDef] left for the outer rim to seize the acknowledgment for [PAWN_possessive] craft [PAWN_pronoun] has always known [PAWN_pronoun] deserves.
LanguageData.REBA024.title: Cave painter
LanguageData.REBA025.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a hunter and gatherer responsible for supplying [PAWN_possessive] tribe with a diverse range of foods. One day [PAWN_pronoun] returned to find [PAWN_possessive] people slaughtered by raiders. Now [PAWN_nameDef] seeks vengeance.
LanguageData.REBA025.title: Hunter and gatherer
LanguageData.REBA026.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a medieval farmer. Although [PAWN_pronoun] was a very capable grower [PAWN_nameDef] always knew that [PAWN_pronoun] was destined for more. Now [PAWN_pronoun] lends [PAWN_possessive] hands in taming the wild outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA026.title: Medieval farmer
LanguageData.REBA027.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a horticulture expert on [PAWN_possessive] glitterworld. Creating gardens was as much an art-form there as a practical pursuit. Now [PAWN_nameDef] seeks to spread beauty and greenery across the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA027.title: Horticulture expert
LanguageData.REBA028.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the best smokeleaf cultivators on [PAWN_possessive] crowded urbworld. Eventually a rival organization threatened his life and he fled to the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA028.title: Smokeleaf cultivator
LanguageData.REBA029.description: Farming the outer rim is as dangerous an occupation as any. [PAWN_nameDef] has survived animal attacks, raiders and crop failures. [PAWN_pronoun] continues to try to eek out a living on this harsh planet.
LanguageData.REBA029.title: Frontier farmer
LanguageData.REBA030.description: Farms on a caveworld look very different to farms on most other worlds. Caveworld growers like [PAWN_nameDef] need to be able to grow a large variety of lichens and mosses to breed bugs for protein. [PAWN_nameDef] has decided to explore the outer rim to find new plants and insects to take back to [PAWN_possessive] home world one day.
LanguageData.REBA030.title: Bug breeder
LanguageData.REBA031.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a tribal scout. [PAWN_pronoun] is responsible for searching out new lands and new ideas, before bringing them back to the tribe. [PAWN_pronoun] has learned a variety of skills to act independently while away from [PAWN_possessive] tribe. One day [PAWN_nameDef] will return to [PAWN_possessive] tribal world with [PAWN_possessive] new knowledge.
LanguageData.REBA031.title: Tribal scout
LanguageData.REBA032.description: [PAWN_nameDef] constantly pushed the boundaries of scientific achievement on [PAWN_possessive] home world, inventing many ingenious contraptions. Eventually though [PAWN_pronoun] knew that in order to learn more he would have to pack up [PAWN_possessive] workshop and travel the stars. Now [PAWN_nameDef] experiments in the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA032.title: Medieval inventor
LanguageData.REBA033.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has a very deep knowledge of complex scientific concepts. A true genius, [PAWN_pronoun] has decided that in order to further [PAWN_possessive] knowledge [PAWN_pronoun] needs to explore the very limits of civilization. Whether [PAWN_nameDef] will survive or not, only time will tell.
LanguageData.REBA033.title: Theoretical scientist
LanguageData.REBA034.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was responsible for the creation of many medical and recreational drugs on [PAWN_possessive] crowded urbworld. Eventually [PAWN_nameDef] decided to explore the outer rim to find even more potent reagents for [PAWN_possessive] concoctions.
LanguageData.REBA034.title: Chemist
LanguageData.REBA035.description: The resources required to fabricate new technology are sometimes hard to come by in the outer rim. [PAWN_nameDef] takes existing inventions and tinkers with them to discover improvements. [PAWN_pronoun] has almost blown [PAWN_objective]self up on multiple occasions.
LanguageData.REBA035.title: Tinkerer
LanguageData.REBA036.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was responsible for researching the different rock and mineral types on [PAWN_possessive] caveworld. Now [PAWN_pronoun] explores the geology of the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA036.title: Geologist
LanguageData.REBA037.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a tribal digger. [PAWN_pronoun] was responsible for moving large amounts of earth in order to create primitive buildings or farmland.
LanguageData.REBA037.title: Digger
LanguageData.REBA038.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a miner on his medieval home world. [PAWN_pronoun] is comfortable deep within the earth, pick in hand. [PAWN_nameDef] has traveled to the outer rim to strike it rich.
LanguageData.REBA038.title: Medieval miner
LanguageData.REBA039.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an asteroid excavator, shattering asteroids for [PAWN_possessive] glitterworld to get to the precious resources inside. Now [PAWN_nameDef] uses [PAWN_possessive] knowledge of minerals to exploit planets on the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA039.title: Asteroid excavator
LanguageData.REBA040.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a sewer runner on [PAWN_possessive] crowded urbworld. [PAWN_pronoun] ran through the underground tunnels underneath the cities exploring. Now [PAWN_pronoun] uses [PAWN_possessive] talents to help explore the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA040.title: Sewer runner
LanguageData.REBA041.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a prospector of the outer rim. [PAWN_possessive] job is to find and exploit valuable mineral deposits.
LanguageData.REBA041.title: Prospector
LanguageData.REBA042.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a tunneler on his caveworld home. [PAWN_pronoun] was a natural at tunneling beneath the surface and scouting out valuable minerals. Now [PAWN_nameDef] lends his experience to colonies on the outer rim for coin.
LanguageData.REBA042.title: Tunneler
LanguageData.REBA043.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a tribal fire tender. The position of fire tender is highly valued in tribal society for fires multitude of uses.
LanguageData.REBA043.title: Fire tender
LanguageData.REBA044.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a medieval butcher. [PAWN_pronoun] knows [PAWN_possessive] way around a cleaver which is both useful in the kitchen and on the battlefield.
LanguageData.REBA044.title: Medieval butcher
LanguageData.REBA045.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a gastronomical artisan. [PAWN_pronoun] turned cooking into an art form on [PAWN_possessive] glitterworld home.
LanguageData.REBA045.title: Gastronomical artisan
LanguageData.REBA046.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an urbworld brewer. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to make a variety of different alcoholic beverages, a highly sought after skill in the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA046.title: Brewer
LanguageData.REBA047.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a frontier chef in the outer rim. [PAWN_pronoun] cooks delicious meals, just don't ask what's in them!
LanguageData.REBA047.title: Frontier chef
LanguageData.REBA048.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a nutrient paste cook for [PAWN_possessive] caveworld home. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to cook meals from limited ingredients that while not delicious can sustain a person.
LanguageData.REBA048.title: Nutrient paste cook
LanguageData.REBA049.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a tribal hut maker. [PAWN_pronoun] explores the rimworld in the search of better building techniques for [PAWN_possessive] tribe.
LanguageData.REBA049.title: Hut maker
LanguageData.REBA050.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a medieval mason. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to construct beautiful stone structures.
LanguageData.REBA050.title: Medieval mason
LanguageData.REBA051.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a high rise architect. [PAWN_pronoun] has an excellent knowledge of engineering.
LanguageData.REBA051.title: High rise architect
LanguageData.REBA052.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an urban planner. [PAWN_pronoun] has an excellent knowledge of construction.
LanguageData.REBA052.title: Urban planner
LanguageData.REBA053.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a settler on the outer rim. [PAWN_pronoun] knows a variety of useful skills needed to tame this wild land.
LanguageData.REBA053.title: Settler
LanguageData.REBA054.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a warren builder on his caveworld home. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to dig homes out of the very earth.
LanguageData.REBA054.title: Warren builder
LanguageData.REBA055.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a tribal tool maker. [PAWN_pronoun] has the knowledge to create useful tools.
LanguageData.REBA055.title: Tool maker
LanguageData.REBA056.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a medieval blacksmith. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to forge both weapons and armor.
LanguageData.REBA056.title: Medieval blacksmith
LanguageData.REBA057.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a roboticist. [PAWN_pronoun] worked on creating complex robots for a variety of different purposes.
LanguageData.REBA057.title: Roboticist
LanguageData.REBA058.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an urbworld forger. [PAWN_pronoun] can forge a variety of different goods.
LanguageData.REBA058.title: Forger
LanguageData.REBA059.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a gunsmith. [PAWN_pronoun] can forge a variety of different guns.
LanguageData.REBA059.title: Gunsmith
LanguageData.REBA060.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a caveworld artificer. [PAWN_pronoun] can create a variety of different tools and weapons out of exotic materials.
LanguageData.REBA060.title: Artificer
LanguageData.REBA061.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a tribal herder. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to tame and take care of animals.
LanguageData.REBA061.title: Herder
LanguageData.REBA062.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a medieval stable master. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to breed and take care of animals.
LanguageData.REBA062.title: Stable master
LanguageData.REBA063.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a glitterworld zoologist. [PAWN_pronoun] wanders the outer rim documenting the various exotic animals.
LanguageData.REBA063.title: Zoologist
LanguageData.REBA064.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an illegal urbworld breeder. [PAWN_pronoun] bred exotic and dangerous animals for a premium.
LanguageData.REBA064.title: Illegal breeder
LanguageData.REBA065.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an outer rim rancher. [PAWN_pronoun] breeds and takes care of exotic rimworld animals.
LanguageData.REBA065.title: Rancher
LanguageData.REBA066.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a caveworld mole rat farmer. [PAWN_pronoun] bred moles in the depths of the earth to feed [PAWN_possessive] people.
LanguageData.REBA066.title: Mole rat farmer
LanguageData.REBA067.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a tribal warrior. [PAWN_pronoun] is fierce looking with [PAWN_possessive] tribal tattoos and [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to use a variety of melee weapons to maim and kill.
LanguageData.REBA067.title: Tribal warrior
LanguageData.REBA068.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a medieval knight. [PAWN_pronoun] believes in chivalry and honor. [PAWN_nameDef] has traveled to the outer rim to obtain the glory [PAWN_pronoun] knows is [PAWN_possessive] destiny.
LanguageData.REBA068.title: Medieval knight
LanguageData.REBA069.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a glitterworld peacekeeper. [PAWN_pronoun] is in charge of keeping the peace all over the galaxy. Right now [PAWN_nameDef] is stationed in the outer rim.
LanguageData.REBA069.title: Peacekeeper
LanguageData.REBA070.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an urbworld member of the riot police. [PAWN_pronoun] was in charge of ensuring that the people of [PAWN_possessive] urbworld respected the law.
LanguageData.REBA070.title: Riot police
LanguageData.REBA071.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a bar owner in the outer rim. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to cook and how to crack the occasional raider skull.
LanguageData.REBA071.title: Bar owner
LanguageData.REBA072.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a strike breaker on the caveworld [PAWN_pronoun] called home. [PAWN_pronoun] learned how to both talk [PAWN_possessive] way out of trouble and how to crack some skulls when talking didn't work.
LanguageData.REBA072.title: Strike breaker
